A binary is not just an executable. There are many dependencies that the binary links to and if you don't have everything it needs, you will have a bad time.

With Waterfox, though, I would think that they include all the library files needed and links to the programs root folder instead of the system libs. For example, many developers used Sourceforge to share their programs and sometimes source code. But, they injected malware into the installers.
